script:
control-agent-server api POST /api/plugins/install --json '{"source": "github:<redacted:unrelated-repository>", "repo_path": "plugins/city-weather", "force": true}' \
  --timeout 240 --expect 200 --check name eq city-weather --save F26.install-documented-source/working-form
control-agent-server api DELETE /api/plugins/installed/city-weather --expect 200
DOC=$(control-agent-server api GET /openapi.json --auth none --field components.schemas.InstallPluginRequest.properties.source.description)
case "$DOC" in
  *"'github:<redacted:unrelated-repository>/plugins/city-weather'"*)
    control-agent-server api POST /api/plugins/install --json '{"source": "github:<redacted:unrelated-repository>/plugins/city-weather"}' \
      --timeout 240 --expect 200 --check name eq city-weather --save F26.install-documented-source/documented  # bug
    control-agent-server api DELETE /api/plugins/installed/city-weather --expect 200
    ;;
esac
failed_command: control-agent-server api POST /api/plugins/install --json '{"source": "github:<redacted:unrelated-repository>/plugins/city-weather"}' --timeout 240 --expect 200 --check name eq city-weather --save F26.install-documented-source/documented
